memoryRule: a measured visitor stroke lets the membrane choose its weakest contour, rupture it, and relay strain to a non-local ring; the changed field affects later choices
interactionRule: drag and release submits a stroke; short strokes are refused; Enter, Space, and the strain control submit a deterministic cue; Delete lifts the latest; R releases memory
representationRupture: single Canvas solid, suspended WebGL mobile, binary HTML atlas -> browser-native SVG membrane of nested openable contours
encounterRupture: orbit-and-seal, approach-and-departure, and binary choice -> draw-and-release measurement with no visitor-selected target
temporalRupture: unseen-face archive -> bounded strain field that changes the resistance used by the next rupture
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, interaction evidence, independent caption-free perceptual review, production readback, and provider revision linkage
